A solid lead magnet pulls in subscribers even while you sleep. The trick is shipping one quickly so you can test and refine.

Pick a Topic Your Audience Craves

Look at the questions people ask you most. Turn one answer into a short checklist, video, or worksheet.

Keep It Short and Useful

Long ebooks rarely get read. Aim for a bite-size resource that solves a single problem.

Quick Ideas

  • Cheatsheets
  • Short video tutorials
  • One-page templates

Build It with GrowLab

Fire up the Lead Magnet Maker and drop in your text. The design is handled, and you can export a polished PDF in minutes.

You've Got This

Start collecting emails today. A simple lead magnet can open the door to future sales without weeks of prep.
